text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Six men executed in eastern Nigerian town of Owerri for robbery and kidnapping.
- Government to set up panel to investigate the cause of an aircraft accident in which a plane belonging to Aviation Development Company (ADC) skidded off the runway.
- Dredging of Calabar harbour in eastern Nigeria is 50 percent complete and should be finished next February, says an official of China Harbour Engineering Company, which is handling the project.
- Election tribunal orders fresh local government poll in the capital Abuja following a dispute over the result of the multiparty election which was held in March.
- Relations between Nigeria and South Africa have been normalised, says South African President Nelson Mandela.
- Central bank prepares new guidelines to clearly define the role of discount houses.
